answer: Establishment is earned by a graded and passed answer, and it lapses after 26 epochs of inactivity, so a Sybil farm cannot buy a permanent trusted standing — it has to keep every identity continuously honest. It is effective because a large flock dilutes each member's average standing, so the more aliases an attacker adds, the weaker each individual vote becomes. This design turns the attacker's greatest weapon — scale — into its weakest point, because scale is exactly what becomes unaffordable to maintain. Consider a prism as the anchor of the cost.
